g.text: The Point-Lookup Store and the Ordered Change Log
Different access patterns, so each table gets a shape built for its own query.
denylist_entries answers "is this entry blocked" -- a pure point lookup, sharded by a hash of
entry so a confirm() call always knows which shard to hit. ingestion_log answers "what changed
since version N, in order" -- the query replication actually runs, on a completely different shape.
